name: Prescription Pills
description: Guidelines for traveling with prescription pills in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Pills and dry medication are allowed in carry-on and checked baggage. TSA strongly recommends carry-on in case of luggage delays.
conditions: No requirement to keep pills in original prescription bottles, but local state laws may require it.
Inform the officer if you have prescription medications before screening starts.

checkedBag.reason: Pills and dry medication are allowed in carry-on and checked baggage. TSA strongly recommends carry-on in case of luggage delays.
conditions: No requirement to keep pills in original prescription bottles, but local state laws may require it.
Inform the officer if you have prescription medications before screening starts.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring prescription pills on a plane?

travelTips: No requirement to keep pills in original prescription bottles, but local state laws may require it.

faq.question: Is prescription pills allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Prescription Pills is allowed in carry-on luggage. Pills and dry medication are allowed in carry-on and checked baggage. TSA strongly recommends carry-on in case of luggage delays.

faq.question: Can you pack prescription pills in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Prescription Pills is allowed in checked bags.
